name: MCIPCD1
tagline: Five-port 2.5GbE industrial computer with dual COM
description: MCIPCD1 provides five Intel I225 2.5GbE ports on the front panel, with four-port PoE available as an option. Intel N5095 or N5105, up to 32 GB DDR4-3200, dual DB9 COM, HDMI and VGA support industrial equipment and network integration. The enclosure measures 187 × 120 × 50 mm.
highlights: 5 × Intel I225 2.5GbE RJ45, optional PoE on 4 ports
